integrity: The proof is stated for the full countable finite-support join-prime group. A standalone bounded checker accompanies, but is not the proof. Source unique factorization is also independently recovered by the minimal-nonface hypergraph argument.
scientific_limitations: Only algebraically affine maps for the signed-divisor Alexandrov topology are classified; arbitrary continuous selfmaps and other group topologies are outside scope. Earlier finite-rank punctured homeomorphism-group results are not claimed anew. Published-source priority cannot be conclusively established from search results.
title: Continuous affine maps and the exact functoriality obstruction for join-Grothendieck spaces
